system.description: While equipped with this shield, a Flying unit takes substantially less Effective damage from Bows (1.35x Atk instead of 2x)

Grant protection to an adjacent friendly unit. You move into that unit's square. The protected unit must be your size or smaller. While on top of that protected unit, it cannot be targeted by any hostile actions, including Area wide effects. 

This effect breaks when either you or the protected unit exit the same square.

The holy weapon of a Divine Guardian. 

Capable of either Slashing or Holy damage.

Your weapon becomes imbued with divine magic, wreaking devastation upon any evil it comes into contact with. 

Your weapon attack gains Occultbreaker and becomes Effective against Undead type units. This attack cannot make extra attacks. On hit, you deal an additional 3d6 Holy damage and 1d4 Brk damage (Holy damage is doubled if the target is Undead).

Heal yourself or an adjacent allied unit by 2d6 + Cha HP and 1d4 Stn. 

 Uses: 5 per Divine Proficiency rank
